description: This file defines the NotesDatabase class which is an abstract class extending RoomDatabase, providing an interface to the SQLite database for note entities, including a singleton pattern for instance management.

classes.name: NotesDatabase
classes.description: Abstract RoomDatabase class acting as a singleton accessor for the notes database, exposing noteDao() and managing database instantiation.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of NotesDatabase; creates it if it does not already exist, configured with Room's databaseBuilder.
